description: Option C two-bucket recall evaluation benchmark built from real 2025-2026 record-label signing announcements. Targets emerging artists with 200-100,000 YouTube subscribers (and <100k Spotify monthly listeners where indexed) and low-to-moderate video views. Separates in-map extraction recall (6 artists touching seeded NYC/session sources) from out-of-map cold source discovery (4 artists outside seeded sources).

selection_criteria.verified_via: Live YouTube watch-page metadata + public web/Spotify index checks on 2026-11-21

buckets.in_map: Artists whose live rooms, session channels, or local directories overlap active sources in data/reference/discovery_sources_seed.json (tests extraction recall).
buckets.out_of_map: Artists signed to labels who sit outside our seeded NYC + US session source map (tests cold source discovery via google_search).

recommended_run_briefs.search_brief: Emerging NYC indie, art-rock, and singer-songwriter acts playing Brooklyn and Lower East Side showcase rooms (Union Pool, Baby's All Right, Mercury Lounge, Pianos) or featured on Audiotree, KEXP, Bandcamp New York, and BrooklynVegan.
recommended_run_briefs.leakage_check: Does not mention record labels or artist names.

recommended_run_briefs.search_brief: Minimalist ambient-folk and indie singer-songwriter vocalists on Bandcamp and independent tastemaker blogs with stripped-back live sets.
recommended_run_briefs.leakage_check: Does not mention record labels or artist names.

recommended_run_briefs.search_brief: Under-the-radar emerging vocalists and bands outside New York (Los Angeles, Ireland, US indie/shoegaze, spiritual jazz-soul) with under 100k followers and early live or official video releases.
recommended_run_briefs.leakage_check: Does not mention record labels or artist names.
